title: Historical Disc Discovered During Excavation
summary: The Department has confirmed the discovery of an unidentified historical disc during an archaeological excavation.

banner.caption: Excavation Site 4 — recovery in progress. Image: Department of ACTONA.

body: The Department has confirmed the discovery of an unidentified historical disc during an archaeological excavation carried out under a routine site survey.
The object was recovered in a stable condition and has been transferred to the Department's archival facilities for cataloguing and analysis.
Initial assessment classifies the material as archaeological in nature. Further findings will be published as the review process continues.
The Department is coordinating the analysis of the object and any associated materials found at the site.
